name: the opt-in gate never stops the script
why: jungleland.it support is opt-in (sa_enable_jungleland, default off). Without the gate the script would put its toolbar on the site's page with the setting off; the spec must see a heading and toolbar appear.

name: the frame gate never stops the script
why: list.htm is normally the 25 % left frame of artwork.htm, and the header has no @noframes. Without the frame gate the script injects its toolbar into that frame; the spec must see it.

name: no <h1> is injected for the toolbar
why: The page has no heading at all; without the injected <h1> the init block stops at the required-elements check and no button is offered.

name: the date stays in the title
why: Every dated entry ends in (YYYY-MM-DD); not matching it leaves the date in Title and empties Date. The spec reads titles without their date.
grep: the date is cut off the title

name: Year from the section heading, not from the date
why: A dated entry under 'others' must get its date's year; taking the section gives it 'others'. The spec pins the Köln row's 2007 and Year == the date's year for every dated row.
grep: the date is cut off the title

name: the Title link keeps the site's frame target
why: Standalone there is no inferioredx1 frame; each click would open (or reuse) a window of that name instead of a plain new tab. The spec pins target=_blank on every row.

name: the dead jump menu stays visible
why: Its anchors are removed with the year headings, so the menu would jump nowhere; it is hidden (not removed).

name: no <h2> before the table
why: updateH2Count() anchors the count and filter bar to the last <h2> before the table; the page has none of its own.

name: the shared table look is not installed on jungleland.it
why: The site has no MusicBrainz CSS; without _ensureForeignTableStyle() the table has no borders or padding.

name: the converter is not called on Load from Disk
why: After a reload the live page holds the plain list again; without the converter the disk path renders into a shell it fabricates, and the list stays.

name: the detection loop compares 'has a host' instead of WHICH host
why: With a boolean comparison every non-MusicBrainz definition is considered on both foreign hosts. No springsteenlyrics matcher claims /html/list.htm and the jungleland one does not claim an SL path, so nothing observable changes today: a guard for the next broad matcher, recorded honestly as invisible.

name: the detection loop ignores the host
why: Without the host comparison every MusicBrainz matcher is tried on jungleland.it too, before jl-list (it sits last). Checked 2026-10-06: none of them claims /html/list.htm, so detection gives the same answer and the spec cannot see it. Recorded honestly; the guard exists for the next broad path.includes() matcher.

name: the @include line is missing
why: Tampermonkey would never inject the script on list.htm; the fixture harness injects unconditionally, so only the regex spec can see it.

name: the Date column is not split
why: jl-list feeds its ISO Date to the MusicBrainz dateParts extractor; without the columnExtractors entry DD/MM/YYYY/Day/Month never appear, and the split spec must miss them.

name: Version ignores the _N suffix
why: The issue number lives in the link's _N suffix (the title is sometimes cut off before its "(Version N)"); a reader that always says 1 must be caught.

name: Version is read from the resolved URL, not the written href
why: The row builder passes getAttribute('href'). Reading anchor.href instead still ends in _N.htm, so the column is unchanged: recorded so the guard is known to be redundant, not missing.

name: DD is not an integer column
why: Checked 2026-10-06: DD still sorts as a number without its integerColumns entry, because the sort recognises all-digit cells by content; the entry only right-aligns the column. Recorded so the numeric order is known to rest on the sort, not on this entry.
